name: Sika AnchorFix Resin Stoppers
paste:
SIKA ANCHORFIX® RESIN STOPPERS: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers, April 2023, Version 01.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sika-anchorfix-resinstoppers.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02).
1.2 Product description. Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers is a tool for filling deep and / or large diameter drilled holes by eliminating air voids. It is used with a Sika Anchorfix® flexible tube which is fixed onto the static mixer.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Eliminating air voids in deep and / or large diameter drilled holes
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: AnchorFix tool to eliminate air voids in resin
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals / certificates.
    - Resin stoppers are referenced in the corresponding approvals of each Sika AnchorFix® product
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Easy to use
    - Re-usable (not a one use item)
    - Diameter options for all drill hole sizes
    - Full set available
    - Prevents air voids in drill holes
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: black
2.5 Dimensions. Resin Stoppers
    | Ø Diameter: (outer) | Ø Diameter (inner) | Length |
    | 18 mm | 14 mm (thread) | 60 mm |
    | 22 mm | 14 mm (thread) | 60 mm |
    | 30 mm | 14 mm (thread) | 60 mm |
    | 36 mm | 14 mm (thread) | 60 mm |
    | 42 mm | 14 mm (thread) | 60 mm |
    | 50 mm | 14 mm (thread) | 60 mm |
    | Flexible Tubes |
    | Ø Diameter: (outer) | Ø Diameter (inner) | Length |
    | 14 mm | 10 mm | 300 mm |
    | 14 mm | 10 mm | 1000 mm |
    (Table as printed; a cell that wraps appears over several rows.)
2.6 System structure. Ancillary products:
    - Sika AnchorFix ® Static Mixer / Nozzle
    - 14 mm (9/16”) O/D reinforced flexible tube
2.7 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Resin Stoppers; Bag of 1 piece / diameter; Bag of 10 pieces / diameter; Bag of 6 pieces with one piece per diameter: 18–50 mm (set)
    - Shelf life: 5 years from the date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 01.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools.
    - General
    - All resin stoppers must be used in conjunction with a 14 mm (9/16”) outer diameter (O/D) Sika Anchorfix® flexible tube.
    - The tube must be applied on the original static mixer of an AnchorFix® product.
    - Installation procedure
    - Insert resin stopper to bottom of the hole. Pump resin material and allow the hole to fill.
    - Always insert the Sika Anchorfix® flexible tube so that it is flush with the outlet of the resin stopper. After use, wipe resin stopper clean with a damp cloth and reuse.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Only use original Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers
4.4 Further information.
    - Sika AnchorFix®: Product Data Sheets
    - Sika Method Statement: Sika AnchorFix®
    - Sika AnchorFix®: Approvals

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 01.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika AnchorFix® Resin Stoppers, April 2023, Version 01.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/1/sika-anchorfix-resinstoppers.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
